text: An architecture with a reward channel but no action surface implements generation as an off-protocol act whose outputs cannot enter the protocol's action set, so the protocol's possibility space remains exogenous no matter how generatively active the agent population is.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Possibility Loops An Operational Architecture for Computative Economics in Agent Coordination Systems (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6655138

isBasedOn.name: Possibility Loops An Operational Architecture for Computative Economics in Agent Coordination Systems

abstract: An architecture that has the reward channel but no action surface implements G as an off-protocol act whose outputs cannot enter the protocol's action set, and the protocol's possibility space remains exogenous regardless of how active G is in the agent population.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: protocols lacking a settlement-layer interface for posting generative output
